title: Murder of Sheena Bora
narrative: FIR — 24 April 2012, Bandra, Mumbai. Sheena Bora, aged 25, was strangled. The accused are Indrani Mukerjea (her mother), Sanjeev Khanna (Indrani's ex-husband), Peter Mukerjea (Indrani's husband) and the driver Shyamvar Rai, who later turned approver. The body was taken to Gagode village in Raigad district, doused in petrol and burned. DNA from a femur bone matched Indrani Mukerjea. The Mumbai Police investigated; charges were filed under IPC sections 302, 201, 364 and 120-B.
